title: Elux Legend Raspberry Watermelon Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Raspberry Watermelon Nic Salt blends the bright, tangy flavour of fresh Raspberry with the juicy sweetness of Watermelon for a refreshing and fruity all-day vape. This e-liquid delivers a smooth and well-balanced flavour profile, making it a must-try for fans of berry and melon blends. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to replicate the bold and intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. With a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide near-instant nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, delivering a satisfying and flavoursome vape experience. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Raspberry Watermelon Nic Salt is perfect for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod kits. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is a versatile and refreshing choice for adult smokers and vapers.
